visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in an outdoor park setting during daytime. A young man with black hair, wearing a black puffer jacket over a beige turtleneck, is lying down on a wooden bench, looking physically exhausted with his eyes partially closed. He sits up abruptly and begins to cough into his hand, showing signs of distress. The background features green grass, trees, and city traffic in the distance under overcast lighting. (2) The visual cuts to a luxurious indoor medical clinic environment. The interior is brightly lit with white walls and high-end gold accents, featuring a large, ornate crystal chandelier. The man walks through the lobby, gesturing at the high-end decor and smiling. A receptionist is briefly visible in the background behind a curved white counter. (3) Inside a consultation room, the man sits across from a male doctor wearing a white lab coat and glasses. The doctor examines the man's face closely, pointing at his eye area. The man touches his own cheek and temple while talking. The lighting is bright studio-style, and a mirror and medical equipment are visible on the table. (4) The man is now lying on a treatment bed wearing a white hairnet and a white drape. A medical technician's hands, wearing blue nitrile gloves, are seen applying a silver medical device to the man's jawline and forehead. The man's face is covered in a clear gel, and he remains still during the procedure. (5) The setting shifts to an indoor room where the man stands in front of a plain background, vlogging directly to the camera. He wears a white sweatshirt. Split-screen comparisons appear, showing 'Before' and 'After' photos of his jawline and eye area. Red circles and arrows are overlaid on the photos to highlight skin lifting and reduced wrinkles. (6) The man continues his high-energy presentation, gesturing with his hands and pointing toward the bottom of the screen. He smiles broadly, showing a much more vibrant and refreshed facial appearance compared to the start of the video. The framing is a medium shot focusing on his upper body and facial expressions.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a low-level urban ambient noise floor featuring distant car engines. A female voice speaks with a friendly, inquiring tone, followed by the main male speaker who sounds physically weak and lets out a dry cough. No music is present yet. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' transition sound occurs, immediately followed by the introduction of an upbeat, mid-tempo electronic pop BGM with a steady 4/4 synthetic beat. The male speaker's voice transforms into a high-arousal, energetic narration style with fast speech delivery. (3) During the consultation, the male speaker interacts with a second male voice (the doctor), who speaks with a professional, calm, and enunciated broadcasting quality. A high-pitched 'ding' sparkle SFX highlights a comedic moment. The BGM remains as a consistent background bed. (4) A short sequence features the rhythmic, high-frequency mechanical pulses and beeps of a medical device, indicating the procedure is in progress. Speech is absent here, while the music volume is slightly attenuated. (5) The final phase features a continuous high-energy vocal delivery from the main speaker. Multiple sharp 'whoosh' SFX are synchronized with visual image transitions. The audio concludes with a stylized laugh track and applause SFX, as the music reaches its peak intensity before a hard cut.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional vlog intended to showcase the effectiveness of medical beauty treatments (Ultherapy and Botox) at a specific clinic. It uses a personal 'before and after' journey to build trust and encourage viewers to interact with the content for a chance to receive a gift.
